title: App pages with screenshots and features
lede: Five product pages show the actual apps, the work they support and whether they are released or in development.

stats.n: All five directory listings have a detail page.
Real captures and published artwork; generated test media is labeled.
Public routes, versions, download guards, image format and dimensions.

sections.heading: Existing pages, matched comparison
sections.note: Same 822 × 988 viewport, light appearance, public facts and top scroll position. Before is production revision d396910; after is the retained source snapshot. JPEG browser captures were decoded losslessly to PNG for the receipt builder; original JPEGs are retained privately.

pairs.title: Fetch
pairs.beforeCap: Link-only copy and no rendered screenshots.
pairs.afterCap: Download and conversion overview with the real 1.5.4 opening window.

pairs.title: Offload
pairs.beforeCap: Older feature copy and no rendered screenshots.
pairs.afterCap: Public 1.5.3 preview, verified-copy workflow and accurate archive handoff.

pairs.title: Apps directory
pairs.beforeCap: Three apps had no detail-page link.
pairs.afterCap: Every app has a feature page, with current version fallbacks and supported download links.

changes.h: Show the app before the details
changes.was: Product pages opened with text and missing screenshot slots.
changes.now: Each page opens with a real screenshot and gives access to the original image.

changes.was: Unreleased app listings had no useful feature overview.
changes.now: Radio Clip and Media Lab explain the development workflow and use explicitly labeled sample-data previews without download buttons.

changes.was: Offload could reuse an old requirement or download fallback when live metadata changed.
changes.now: Known requirements belong to the matching version; missing release assets do not produce a download action.

verification: Production-shaped application build passed; TypeScript passed after build-generated files settled.
Repository lint: 0 errors, 43 pre-existing warnings. Documentation maps and git diff checks passed.
All five pages checked at 1280 × 720 and 390 × 844 without page overflow. Fetch workflow and original-image links work from the keyboard.
Light and dark appearance controls persist across reload. Phone screenshots stack vertically; the focused image fits fully within the viewport.
notes: The three new pages have after-only evidence; there was no previous product page to compare.
The preview uses static public content with no authenticated team or archive data. It does not prove native ingest, transcription accuracy or physical-device behavior.
Production publication and CI are pending at the time this review was prepared.
